name: redis
summary: Keep the read model in Redis and carry events on Redis Streams, so several API instances share one store.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.comment: The Redis server the document store and the event bus connect to

env.name: NYMBAL_REDIS_PREFIX
env.comment: Starts every key and stream name, so stores can share one server (default nymbal)

next: Start a Redis server (docker run -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine) and point REDIS_URL at it.
Then nymbal dev: the API connects to Redis when it starts.
